Build a TypeScript data structures deep dive focused on stacks, queues, and binary search.

Scope: Trace invariants and repair a stack, queue, and binary search.

Prerequisites: Assumes functions, loops, arrays, and basic TypeScript. This bounded deep dive examines three structures rather than surveying every data structure.

These assets were authored for an isolated acceptance run, using the public authoring workflow. They replace all template curriculum, lessons, and examples. No shared application source changes are needed.
